sloka: ददर्श सुमहा तेजा न ददर्श च जानकीम् ।निरीक्षमाणः च ततः ताः स्त्रियः स महा कपिः ॥५-११-३६॥
transliteration: dadarśa sumahā tejā na dadarśa ca jānakīm ।nirīkṣamāṇaḥ ca tataḥ tāḥ striyaḥ sa mahā kapiḥ ॥5-11-36॥

translations.english: The great monkey was very much worried as he thought he had transgressed the moral code by watching the women.
